Samsung’s Micro LED technology powers smarter city management at the Iskandar Puteri Command Center (IPCC) in Johor, Malaysia.

With Samsung’s The Wall, multiple urban systems—including security, traffic, environment, and emergency response—are unified into one real-time command hub for faster coordination and decision-making.

Designed to fit the building’s semicircular structure, the curved display delivers exceptional clarity, brightness, and an immersive visual experience.

Discover more at http://smsng.co/yt_B2Bsolutions
